new_result.name: QFORM-CROSS-SINGULAR-TAIL-RESERVE-v1
new_result.statement_compact: For A=A0+E and physical cross block M0=A0[I,J], D=E[I,J], if q+5<=min(|I|,|J|), eta=s_{q+1}(D), and b_k=(s_{q+k}(M0)-eta)_+ are positive for k=1..5, then Q has continuous density with ||p_Q||inf <= 5 sqrt(2e) (product b_k)^(-1/5).
new_result.mechanism: Singular-value Weyl absorbs q arbitrary-amplitude cross directions and pays only s_{q+1}(D); the actual final five-volume is then bounded below and D5 closes the density estimate.

partner_result_applied.name: QFORM-THRESHOLDED-CROSS-FOOTPRINT-HYBRID-v1
partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: With D=D_q+D_tail, rank D_q<=q and ||D_tail||=eta, the partner baseline has cross block M0+D_q and a_k=(s_k(M0+D_q)-eta)_+ >= (s_{q+k}(M0)-eta)_+=b_k, so its D5 branch yields the stated bound.

terminal_theorem.name: D5 five-cross-volume bound
terminal_theorem.scope: Any original-coordinate physical cross block; no leverage condition; continuous density via L1 Fourier inversion.

global_spectral_corollary: Since s_{q+1}(E[I,J])<=s_{q+1}(E)=|theta_{q+1}|, the first q added eigenvalues can be arbitrarily large, signed and oriented; all remaining eigenvalues are paid only through the largest residual magnitude, at the cost of q additional baseline cross singular directions.
explicit_family: For A0=[[0,2I_m],[2I_m,0]], m=q+5, every symmetric E with s_{q+1}(E)<=1/4 has continuous output density <=20 sqrt(2e)/7=6.661839947420355..., uniformly over the first q arbitrary spectral changes; the final matrix remains in the exact target class.
unresolved_implication: From the bare s3(A)>=1 hypothesis, force a reserve/volume physical cut satisfying the theorem, or an exhaustive already-paid localized/ridge/grouped-bank/hub/Schur/product-preserving alternative.
next_step: Study the complementary failure of all cross-singular reserve functionals and derive an aggregate physical-coordinate certificate rather than paying one small minor.
